text: 一个月前，我会回答正是人生最好年华：
en: A month ago, I would have answered that this was precisely the finest time of life:

text: 对上，父母还不算太老，身体健康，不仅能独立自主，偶尔还能帮我分担家事。
en: Upwards, my parents were not yet too old, in good health, not only able to look after themselves independently but occasionally even helping me with the household chores.

text: 对下，孩子高中住校，除了寒暑假需要在家，其他时间基本是放养了，不用管吃喝，也不管学习了，全靠自己。
en: Downwards, my child boarded at senior school; apart from the winter and summer holidays when they needed to be at home, the rest of the time was basically left to their own devices — no need to worry about food and drink, nor about their studies; it was all up to them.

text: 跟老公高中走来20多年，深深的亲情已经刻入骨髓，对方打个屁都知道是为什么。
en: Having come through more than twenty years with my husband since senior school, a deep familial bond has been etched into my marrow — I know exactly why the other lets out a fart.

text: 工作上正是积累了20年的经验，在自己的领域算得上得心应手，在公司心也不委屈，钱也不委屈。
en: At work, I had exactly twenty years of accumulated experience, was more or less at ease in my own field, and at the company neither my heart nor my purse felt wronged.

text: 你永远不知道明天和意外哪一个更早到来
en: You never know which comes earlier — tomorrow or an accident.

text: 一个月内，我父亲，老公父亲，相继查出肠癌，两个人连病床都是你出院，我接着用。
en: Within a single month, my father and my husband's father were both diagnosed with bowel cancer one after another; the two of them even took turns on the same hospital bed — one discharged, the other taking it up.

text: 突然有种巨大的无力感包围着，才能理解子欲养而亲不在。
en: Suddenly enveloped by a huge sense of helplessness, I could finally understand the saying that one wishes to care for one's parents while they are still there, only to find they are gone.

text: 想想陪父母真的是过一天，少一天。
en: Thinking about it, the time spent with one's parents really is one day less for every day that passes.

text: 父亲出院的时候瘦了20斤，看着他虚弱的样子，我一个人这一个月哭的次数比往年一年都多。
en: When my father was discharged he had lost twenty jin; seeing how frail he looked, I cried more in that one month alone than in a whole year in previous years.

text: 钱赚再多，也是丢在医院，没了健康真的就没了一切，突然决定了想离职，换种活法。
en: However much money you earn, it all ends up spent in hospital; without health you truly lose everything, and I suddenly decided I wanted to leave my job and live life a different way.

text: 看到了就来简单讲两句
en: Now that I've seen this, I'll just say a few words.

text: 先说一下自己的情况，我是84年生，男，目前离异，一儿一女，儿12岁，女5岁。
en: Let me first say something about my own situation: I was born in '84, male, currently divorced, with a son and a daughter — the son is twelve, the daughter five.

text: 就我自己的感受来说，35岁左右开始面临两大中年危机：中年失业，中年离异，目前还在渡劫中(中年离异)。
en: Speaking from my own feelings, around the age of thirty-five I began to face two great midlife crises: midlife unemployment and midlife divorce; I am still going through my tribulation (midlife divorce).

text: 先说第一个：中年失业。
en: Let me first speak of the first: midlife unemployment.

text: 其实我中年失业也导致了后面的中年离异，但考虑到有的人中年失业但还能通过铁人三项或回归家庭也未必会导致中年离异，有的人没失业但也会导致中年离异，所以我把它们列为两种情况分别说一说。
en: Actually, my midlife unemployment also led to the midlife divorce that followed, but considering that some people face midlife unemployment yet, whether by taking up the 'ironman triathlon' or returning to the family, do not necessarily end up divorced, while some who were not unemployed still end up divorced, I have listed them as two separate cases to discuss in turn.

text: 我属于互联网/软件行业，我们行业人数占比其实不多，但声量大，所以相信其他行业的朋友应该也有所耳闻，35岁失业不是开玩笑的。
en: I belong to the internet/software industry; our industry's share of the workforce is actually not large, but our voice is loud, so I believe friends in other industries will have heard something of it too — being unemployed at thirty-five is no joke.

text: 如果失业前还负债，那真是天崩开局(我就是这种情况，直接触发了第二条中年离异，警告：这不是段子！
en: If you are also in debt before losing your job, that is truly a heaven-collapse opening (I was in exactly this situation, which directly triggered the second crisis, midlife divorce — warning: this is no joke!

text: 这不是段子！
en: This is no joke!

text: 这不是段子！
en: This is no joke!

text: 我35左右失业后，曾经挣扎着还想找，因为家人当时不同意我创业，我只好找工作，结果没找到合适工作。
en: After I became unemployed at around thirty-five, I struggled and still wanted to find work; because my family then disapproved of my starting a business, I had no choice but to look for a job, but in the end found nothing suitable.

text: 这时，我前妻叫我找到啥做啥，能找的就只有铁人三项，我还不一定能做。
en: At this point, my ex-wife told me to do whatever I could find; the only thing to be found was the ironman triathlon, and even that I might not have been able to do.

text: 我的想法是自己做，为此我已经准备了多年，就是早就知道行业有这种35失业情况。
en: My own thinking was to work for myself; I had prepared for this over many years precisely because I had long known that our industry had this kind of thirty-five unemployment situation.

text: 我爸觉得我不是干铁人三项的料，他觉得那些工作很一般，不适合我们家这样的去干。
en: My dad felt I was not the type for the ironman triathlon; he thought those jobs were very ordinary and unsuitable for someone from a family like ours.

text: 他支持我自己干。
en: He supported me in working for myself.

text: 于是我自己干，先从网上威客平台接单，这些单钱很少，很复杂，不然也轮不到我来接。
en: So I worked for myself, first taking jobs from online crowdsourcing platforms; these jobs paid very little and were very complicated — otherwise they would never have fallen to me.

text: 比如对于很多程序员来说，2000块钱的单子付出可能有两万的时间精力，有的选择都没人接的。
en: For instance, for many programmers, a two-thousand-yuan job might demand twenty-thousand-yuan's worth of time and energy, and some are so undesirable that no one takes them at all.

text: 我就是从接这样的单子开始的。
en: That was how I started — by taking jobs like these.

text: 收入从一万八降到两三千(这已经不是一般程序员能干的事了，我是早就针对性准备了，我本身技术也比较全面，深度也有，有次我拿一个项目跟一个十年PHP同行说，他都听不懂)。
en: My income dropped from eighteen thousand to two or three thousand (and this was already not something an ordinary programmer could do — I had prepared specifically for it long beforehand; my own technical skill is fairly comprehensive, with real depth too; once I described a project to a PHP peer of ten years' experience and he could not even follow it).

text: 但是前妻很不满，觉得我没有按她意思去做，整天指桑骂槐，各种借题发挥。
en: But my ex-wife was very dissatisfied, feeling I had not done as she wished; all day long she made oblique attacks and used every pretext to pick faults.

text: 我知道我的选择是对的，所以我坚持。
en: I knew my choice was right, so I persisted.

text: 从在威客平台接单，半年后朋友介绍单子，注册个体户，注册广西公司，从朋友处接手广州公司，组团队干外包项目，亏本回老家，转型做产品，AI崛起用OPC理念重塑创业路线，到现在已经过去6年。
en: From taking jobs on crowdsourcing platforms, to friends introducing work half a year later, to registering as a sole proprietor, to registering a Guangxi company, to taking over a Guangzhou company from a friend, to forming a team for outsourcing projects, to returning to my hometown at a loss, to pivoting to building products, to reshaping my entrepreneurial path with the OPC philosophy amid the rise of AI — six years have passed to this day.

text: 收入也从朝不保夕变得有稳定月入，已经逐步接近以前打工时的收入(持续开发新产品，收入还会阶梯式增长)。
en: My income, too, went from hand-to-mouth to a stable monthly income, and has gradually drawn close to what I earned as an employee (with continuous new-product development, my income will still grow step by step).

text: 这些都不是铁人三项能比的，说实在的，在挣钱这一块，前妻的眼光显然是不如我的，她一个月三千元工资来指导别人一个月快两万工资的发展路线，这本身就比较魔幻。
en: None of this could be matched by the ironman triathlon; to be honest, when it comes to making money, my ex-wife's judgement was clearly inferior to mine — she, on a monthly wage of three thousand yuan, was directing the development path of someone earning nearly twenty thousand a month, which in itself is rather surreal.

text: 回到前面，我负债的情况下失业，债务不可避免的暴雷。
en: To return to the earlier point: I lost my job while in debt, and the debt inevitably blew up.

text: 她很快就约我去领离婚证。
en: She soon asked me out to collect the divorce certificate.

text: 这就触发了我的第二个难关：中年离异。
en: This triggered my second ordeal: midlife divorce.

text: 我当时也没办法，只好同意了，两个孩子跟她，房子给孩子，跟她说以后还清债了再复合。
en: I had no choice but to agree at the time: the two children would stay with her, the house would go to the children, and I told her we would get back together once I had paid off the debts.

text: 22年6月领的离婚证，现在已经过去四年多，我的债务也快还清了。
en: The divorce certificate was collected in June '22; more than four years have passed since, and my debts are nearly paid off.

text: 其实在领离婚证前，关系已经不好了。
en: Actually, the relationship had already been bad before the divorce certificate was collected.

text: 她借题发挥，经常吵架。
en: She seized on pretexts and we often quarrelled.

text: 加起来有5年左右没有直接沟通了。
en: All told, there has been around five years without direct communication.

text: 这五年来，我发微信她不回的，电话也只能孩子找她，我想跟她商量什么事，都得由父母转告。
en: Over these five years, I sent WeChat messages she did not reply to; calls could only reach her through the children; whenever I wanted to discuss something with her, it had to be passed on by our parents.

text: 这种局面对我来说几乎无解，最近两年来，我做了很多缓和关系的尝试，都被她拒绝。
en: This situation was almost unsolvable for me; over the past two years I made many attempts to ease the relationship, all of which she rejected.

text: 直到昨天晚上，我将最近一段时间总结的她为什么坚决离异的原因，将我的歉意及要做的及希望恢复直接沟通，发微信给她，她才同意直接沟通。
en: It was only last night that I sent her a WeChat message laying out the reasons I had recently summarised for why she was determined to divorce, together with my apology, what I intend to do, and my hope of restoring direct communication; only then did she agree to communicate directly.

text: 总结一下，目前我认为的两大中年危机中的中年失业基本解决，中年离异有缓解的迹象。
en: To sum up, of the two great midlife crises I see at present, midlife unemployment is essentially resolved, and midlife divorce shows signs of easing.

text: 对于中年离异，我有足够的耐心来解决，我相信可以解决的。
en: As for midlife divorce, I have enough patience to resolve it, and I believe it can be resolved.

text: 回到问题，中年是什么体会，我的体会是：挑战地狱模式，发挥你的聪明才智，去解决一个又一个足以让你崩溃的难题。
en: Returning to the question — what is the experience of midlife? My experience is this: take on hell mode, bring your ingenuity into play, and solve one crushing problem after another that is enough to break you.

text: 当你一个个解决后，你可能会感到前所未有的轻松。
en: Once you have solved them one by one, you may feel a lightness you have never known before.

text: 祝中年朋友们都顺利、幸福。
en: I wish all my midlife friends smooth sailing and happiness.
Answered 26.9.16

text: 1980年出生，42岁，女儿13岁，上有两位60多岁老人，老公和我同岁。
en: Born in 1980, aged forty-two, with a thirteen-year-old daughter; above me are two elders in their sixties, and my husband is the same age as me.

text: 谈到40岁，感觉一晃就到了这个年龄，真的感慨时间过的好快啊！
en: Speaking of turning forty, it feels as if I reached this age in the blink of an eye; truly, I marvel at how fast time flies!

text: 似乎昨天我还是个孩子，在父亲的果园里摘果子，今天就要面对40岁这个中年的问题了，时间过的太快了！
en: It seems only yesterday I was a child, picking fruit in my father's orchard, and today I must face the question of forty, this age of middle life — time passes far too fast!

text: 40岁中年是一种什么样的人生体会呢？
en: What is the life experience of being forty and middle-aged?

text: 从几个维度谈谈我40岁的人生体会吧。
en: Let me speak of my life experience at forty from a few dimensions.

text: 我一般会将自己的年度计划按照健康、事业、关系、爱好这四个维度来展开，关于人生体会的这个问题，也从这四个维度来作答。
en: I generally lay out my annual plan along four dimensions — health, career, relationships and hobbies; and I shall answer this question about life experience along these same four dimensions.

text: 健康：
en: Health:

text: 40的身体开始说“不”了，以前很少关注自己的身体，因为无论你做什么身体都无条件的支持并执行。
en: The forty-year-old body begins to say 'no'; previously I rarely paid attention to my body, because whatever you did, it supported and carried out unconditionally.

text: 现在身体开始出现各种的小毛病和小状况，比如我的膝盖受凉就会疼，吹空调的冷风就会狂打喷嚏。
en: Now the body begins to show various minor ailments and small conditions; for example, my knees ache when they catch a chill, and I sneeze uncontrollably when hit by the cold draught of the air conditioning.

text: 现在，需要开始调养自己的身体，更加关注自己的身体健康了。
en: Now, I need to start nurturing my body and pay even more attention to my physical health.

text: 后半生还要一直和身体共处，为了更加健康长寿开始有计划的健身、合理饮食、规律作息、保持心情愉悦等，真正的把健康管理提上日程并严格执行了。
en: I must live with my body for the rest of my life, so, in the interest of healthier and longer living, I have begun planned exercise, a sensible diet, a regular routine, keeping a cheerful mood, and so on — truly putting health management on the agenda and carrying it out strictly.

text: 事业：
en: Career:

text: 不知道别人是怎么样的，我的事业到40岁的时候到达了一个峰值点。
en: I do not know how it is for others, but my career reached a peak point by the time I turned forty.

text: 其实在35岁以后上升的趋势就已经放缓了，只是我还不甘心，要再搏一搏，到40岁的时候我感觉自己到达顶点了。
en: In fact, the upward trend had already slowed after thirty-five; it was only that I was not yet resigned and wanted to struggle on a bit more, and by forty I felt I had reached the summit.

text: 意识到并承认这一点很难，因为在峰值之后就是向下的曲线了，这是不得不承认和面对的事实，这时候调整自己的预期和心态是至关重要的，否则很容易一蹶不振外加心里抑郁。
en: Realising and admitting this is hard, because after the peak comes the downward curve — a fact that must be acknowledged and faced; at this point, adjusting one's expectations and mindset is crucial, otherwise it is all too easy to collapse completely and sink into inner depression.

text: 关系：
en: Relationships:

text: 亲情、友情、爱情，对于这些感情都更加珍惜了。
en: Familial love, friendship, romantic love — I have come to treasure these feelings all the more.

text: 因为随着时间的流逝，最终在你身边始终支持你、温暖你、陪伴你的就是这些亲朋好友和自己的爱人了，所以会格外的珍惜和爱护他们。
en: Because as time passes, it is ultimately these relatives and friends and one's own beloved who remain by your side, supporting, warming and accompanying you to the end, so one cherishes and cares for them all the more.

text: 40岁的中年人，希望生我的人健康长寿，希望我生的人健康成长，希望我的伴侣能一直陪伴左右，并为这些希望去做出很多实际的行动。
en: We forty-year-old middle-agers hope that those who bore us live long and healthy lives, that those we have borne grow up healthy, and that our partners stay by our side always — and we take many practical actions for the sake of these hopes.

text: 爱好：
en: Hobbies:

text: 年轻的时候一心忙工作、忙家庭，忙的没有自己的时间更谈不上自己的爱好了。
en: When young, I was wholly busy with work and family, so busy that I had no time of my own, let alone any hobbies.

text: 40岁的中年人，开始培养一些自己的爱好，享受一下属于自己的时间，和那种全身心投入的福流体验。
en: We forty-year-old middle-agers begin to cultivate some hobbies of our own, to enjoy time that belongs to us, and that experience of total immersion known as flow.

text: 我的爱好比较广泛，看书、写作、唱歌、跳舞。
en: My hobbies are fairly broad: reading, writing, singing, dancing.

text: 等退休以后，这些爱好会让自己的退休生活更加的丰富多彩吧。
en: After retirement, these hobbies will surely make one's retired life all the more rich and varied.

text: 以上就是42岁金花的中年体会，人生过半，好些事情看清了、看淡了、看开了，余下的人生都是自己的创造。
en: The above is the midlife experience of Jinhua, aged forty-two: life is more than half over, many things have been seen clearly, taken lightly and let go, and the remaining life is all of one's own making.
